newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to supplement MOL if demand strong.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to supplement MOL if demand strong.

text.p: Hungary would sell an additional three percent stake in oil and gas company MOL to domestic investors if the original one percent stake is oversubscribed, newspapers reported on Friday.

Hungarian business daily Napi Gazdasag said the board of state privatisation agency APV Rt has decided to supplement the original one percent stake of 984,000 shares with another 2.952 million shares in case of strong demand.

Bourse and money market supervisors said earlier that subscriptions in the domestic public offer will run from May 12 to May 23, but can be closed any time after May 14 once subscriptions have matched the size of the share offer.
APV places a 12.5 percent stake, with a 2.5 percent over-allotment option, to institutional investors privately.
